full_judgment: The appeal is, therefore, allowed without, however, any order as to costs. SCC suit No. 19 of 1980 is hereby decreed. Defendant-respondent shall hand over the possession of the suit premises to the plaintiff-appellants within two (2) months from the date of this judgment failing which the decree will be enforced through Court.
